twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a second step at sign-in with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…). Strongly recommended, it protects your research data even if your password leaks.
twoFactor.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone if you don't have one.
twoFactor.step2: Add a new account in the app and enter this secret key (or open the link below on your phone):
twoFactor.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.
twoFactor.currentCodeLabel: Code from your authenticator app (or a backup code)
twoFactor.invalidCode: Invalid verification code. Please try again.
twoFactor.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Store these somewhere safe (password manager). Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.

logoutAll.title: Sign out everywhere
logoutAll.description: Sign out of every device and browser where this account is logged in, including this one. Use this if you think a device you used is no longer safe.
